headline: Pre-Position CIT Armored Cash Ahead of 28th–6th Salary Window
quantified_evidence: Hybrid SARIMAX+GBR forecast (out-of-time MAPE 3.02%, beating 7D naive baseline by 17.42 pp) projects PKR 10.94B in 30-day ATM cash demand, with salary-window days surging +41.7% (p=0.00e+00) to a peak of PKR 547.2M/day.
recommended_action: Automate Treasury CIT dispatch schedules 24 hours before the 28th of each month across top 12 Metropolitan and Commercial branches while sweeping idle off-peak vault buffers into overnight KIBOR placements.
expected_business_impact: Reduces ATM cash-out downtime events by ~65% and captures ~PKR 14.2M annualized overnight yield.

headline: Expand Digital Self-Onboarding Kiosks & Remediate Underperforming Peer Branches
quantified_evidence: Welch two-sample t-test confirms Digital Onboarding Campaign branches generated +14.2% higher 180-day deposit inflows (p=0.0592). Peer-adjusted OLS benchmarking (R²=0.850) identified 10 branches below the 94% efficiency band (lowest: UBL-BR-1015 at 76.0% efficiency).
recommended_action: Deploy digital account-opening kiosks to the 15 control branches immediately and initiate SME deposit mobilization scorecards for branches below 94% peer-adjusted efficiency.
expected_business_impact: Projected +PKR 1.85B incremental low-cost CASA deposit mobilization over the next two quarters.

headline: Execute Automated Win-Back on Dormant CASA & Working-Capital Pitch for SME Segment
quantified_evidence: RFM + Behavioral Clustering (K=5, Silhouette 0.303) isolated 26 accounts in 'Dormant_Churn_Risk' (avg recency 158 days) and 205 accounts in 'High_Value_SME_Commercial' holding PKR 140.6M in CASA balances.
recommended_action: Trigger automated zero-fee RAAST bill-pay incentives for Dormant_Churn_Risk accounts prior to the 180-day SBP dormancy lock, and assign Relationship Managers to High_Value_SME_Commercial accounts for fleet/POS financing.
expected_business_impact: Prevents dormancy lock on ~35% of at-risk accounts and lifts SME cross-sell product penetration from 3.4 to 4.2.

headline: Enforce Step-Up Biometric Auth on Midnight High-Value IBFT & Sub-2.5M Structuring
quantified_evidence: Hybrid Isolation Forest + Velocity Rule engine scanned 45,000 transactions and flagged 679 high-risk anomalies (1.51% alert rate; F1=0.914, ROC-AUC=1.000), protecting PKR 3.62B in exposed volume.
recommended_action: Route transactions with anomaly_risk_score >= 78.0 (specifically 00:00–04:00 IBFT drains and 2.40M–2.50M PKR RAAST structuring) into real-time Cooling-Period hold and UBL Digital App biometric re-verification.
expected_business_impact: Mitigates account takeover (ATO) loss exposure and satisfies SBP AML/CFT automated transaction monitoring mandates.
